question: In train2's full release recipe (pretrain on nvsynth's every-line set plus VN-style synthetic data, then the real fine-tune), does the study-1 mix (synth2 0.25 + synth3 v2 0.25) as the VN-style synthetic source lower real-screenshot CER on the development cohort compared with synth2 alone (0.5), at FL10 size and at H15 size?

background.study1: eval/synth3_ablation_20261012.json (commit 6803fd9), short recipe (16,000 pretrain steps, nvsynth one-line set, no fine-tune, FL10, seeds 1-2): C_mix - A_s2 = -0.505 points (VN-cluster 95% CI -0.765 to -0.259), C_mix - B_s3 = -0.491 (CI -0.736 to -0.252), B_s3 - A_s2 = -0.015 (CI -0.337 to +0.304). Under study 1's rule the mix is the recommended VN-style synthetic data.
background.why_study2: train2 found that the pretrain does most of the work and the real fine-tune adds -0.4 to -0.9 points on teacher_val. A synthetic-data gain in a short pretrain can shrink or vanish once nvsynth's 12M every-line crops, 2-2.5x more steps and the real fine-tune are added; the released models were trained that way, so the decision that matters for a release is made here.
background.arms_chosen: A (synth2, the released recipe) against study 1's winner C (the mix). B (synth3 alone) is not carried: C beat it in study 1. A version-3 synth3 arm is not included: study 1b (agent synth3-v3) had no committed result when this protocol was committed.

machine: build-host (64 AMD EPYC 9R14 cores, the same CPU model as study 1's box). Every study-2 run trains here through heavy.sh with HEAVY_SLOTS=10 (at most 10 concurrent training runs), 5 torch threads per run. A re-run of study 1's B_s3_seed1 on this machine reproduced study 1's logged CTC loss and per-source draw counts at steps 100, 200 and 300 exactly.

FL10.note: the shipped VOCR1 topology (657,664-byte W8I blob, 124,832-byte arena)

H15.note: the overlay default VOCR_H15's topology (1,155,968-byte W8I blob, 182,944-byte arena)

finetune.mixture: nv 0.25 + the arm's VN-style synthetic data 0.25 + tt 0.275 + rd 0.125 + ps 0.1; real sources inv=0.5

the fine-tune starts from the pretrain's final checkpoint; the released FL10 started from pl10's best teacher_val checkpoint (step 28,000), a selection this protocol does not make

order: FL10 seeds 1-3 of both arms first (the most decision-relevant size: VOCR3-FL10 against VOCR1 and VOCR2), then H15 seed 1 and seed 2 of both arms, then the step curve, then the learning curve; a run starts when a training slot is free (study-1 secondaries and study 1b share the 10 training slots)
checkpoint: the fine-tune's ckpt_step15000.pt (EMA weights). No checkpoint selection: the in-training teacher_val evaluations are logged for monitoring only.
export: eval/synth3_ablation.py export (train/export.py, per-channel int8) -> C runtime W8I through runtime/pyvocr.py, max width 1024

devnative.role: co-primary if and only if its cohort manifest is committed on origin (devnative.status COHORT_FROZEN <sha>) before the first study-2 development score is computed; otherwise reported only
devnative.subsets: its strict and tv_native subsets decide; its scene_vn subset (VNs whose other screenshots were synth2 scene backgrounds, which both arms train on) is reported only
devnative.note: the native Vita/PSP development cohort of agent devnative (VNDB console screenshots, C GRAD finder and ink-box crops, engine readings adjudicated and reviewed by Claude); scored by eval/synth3_ablation.py score unchanged

metric: CER (eval/metrics.norm both sides, Levenshtein over reference characters) over all development lines, both views, errors summed over the arm's seeds
decision: For each architecture separately, C_mix is better than A_s2 iff (1) on teacher_val the VN-cluster 95% interval of CER(C_mix) - CER(A_s2) lies entirely below 0, (2) CER(C_mix) - CER(A_s2) < 0 on teacher_val for each seed pair (same seed), and (3) when devnative is co-primary, its VN-cluster 95% interval (same runs and views) also lies entirely below 0. A_s2 is better than C_mix under the mirrored rule. Otherwise neither is better and the result is reported as no measured difference. The recommended VN-style synthetic data for that size is the better arm's; with no measured difference it is synth2 (the released recipe), and study 1's result is reported alongside.
scoring_order: The FL10 comparison is scored once all six FL10 fine-tunes have ckpt_step15000.pt; the H15 comparison once all four H15 fine-tunes have. The result JSON records each score's UTC time and the devnative commit, if any, that the co-primary rule used.
reported_not_decided: every stratum of eval/synth3_ablation.py with intervals, per-VN better/worse counts and the largest per-VN regressions (no per-VN veto)
pretrain-only: each run's pretrain final checkpoint exported and scored the same way (C_mix - A_s2 per architecture), comparable with study 1
fine-tuning gain per arm (fine-tuned - pretrain-only, same seeds)
the in-training teacher_val, nvsynth and synth2 validation curves
devnative's subsets when it is not co-primary, and its scene_vn subset always

step_curve.compare: each against ft_FL10_C_mix_seed1 (32,000 pretrain steps) and against each other on teacher_val (VN-cluster and line intervals), scored like the primary runs
step_curve.why: train2's pretrains see 32,000-40,000 steps x 96 lines (3-4M samples) of more than 13M available lines; this measures whether longer pretraining pays at FL10 size

learning_curve.recipe: study 1's B_s3 run exactly (eval/synth3_run_arm.sh: 16,000 steps, nvsynth one-line set 0.5 + synth3 0.5, FL10, seeds 1 and 2), with the synth3 source restricted or extended: eval/synth3_curve_run.sh SIZE SEED

points.1M: study 1's B_s3_seed1 and B_s3_seed2 (study 1's runs, reused: same recipe, CPU model and seeds; see machine)
points.2M: train_v2 shards 00000-00099 + train_v2_ext shards 00100-00199: the unchanged version-2 generator (its recipe.json, including the code sha256s, equals train_v2's; generator code last changed in 4470d4b; seed 20261012, and each shard is seeded by its index, so shards 100-199 are new crops), pinned by data/manifests/synth3_shards_v2_ext.json, committed before any 2M run trains

learning_curve.compare: each point against the next smaller one with study 1's statistics (VN-cluster interval, per-seed deltas); a later protocol may use these results only as it writes down before its own scoring

protected_test: Only after the decision for an architecture and its result are committed: every study-2 fine-tuned and pretrain-only export of that architecture, and the step-curve exports, are scored once on vita-test and psp-test with eval/run.py (vocr: backend, W8I; console polarity primary, native also) and summarised by eval/synth3_test_report.py. Those numbers are reported and cannot change the decision, the recipe or the dataset. Learning-curve exports are not scored on test sets.
hygiene: the same as study 1 (eval/synth3_ablation_protocol.json hygiene): synth3's text, fonts, scenes and names never read teacher_val, a test set or CLANNAD; calibration and mining used training-side pools only
no study-2 run, curve or selection reads vita-test, psp-test, the fresh native textbox test or CLANNAD references

amendments.change: Fixes how devnative is read when it is co-primary, and the tools. devnative writes one npz per subset and crop (devnative_<strict|tv_native|scene_vn>_<ink|grad>.npz, teacher_val's format). Its decision set is the strict and tv_native subsets with both crops (ink + 4/2 px boxes and the checked GRAD finder boxes), pooled into one cohort by eval/synth3_study2.py merge (each crop a separate line; VNs resampled as clusters), read in both views (rv, rvn). scene_vn is scored and reported only. The comparisons and the decision are computed by eval/synth3_study2.py result (study 1's statistics via eval/synth3_ablation.py compare); the reported-only comparisons are listed in eval/synth3_study2_reported.json.
